title: Guinea-Bissau’s NDC 3.0
organization: Government of Guinea-Bissau; submitted to the UNFCCC
methodology: Government NDC summarizes coastal and marine vulnerability and adaptation targets.
limitations: The PDF labels itself draft, although the UNFCCC registry records the submission as active.

title: Fourth National Communication Report (NC4) to the UNFCCC
organization: Government of Guinea-Bissau, Ministry of Environment, Biodiversity and Climate Action; UNEP and GEF provided technical and financial support
temporal_coverage: Observed impacts and climate vulnerabilities reported in the 2025 national communication
methodology: Government national communication with participatory preparation and sectoral vulnerability assessment.
limitations: The report reserves all rights and requires prior authorization for reproduction; reported impacts are not independently validated here.

title: Guinea-Bissau: 2020 Updated NDC
methodology: Government NDC reports national and regional climate projections and vulnerability assessments.
limitations: Projection uncertainty is noted; the cited passages do not quantify resulting damages.

title: Guinea-Bissau Country Climate and Development Report
temporal_coverage: Current diagnostics and modeled climate, mobility and development effects through 2050 and 2100
methodology: Country climate-development diagnostic with modeled impacts and fragility review.
limitations: National analysis; some local and farmer-herder links are conditional.

title: The Sea Swallowed our Houses and Rice Fields: The Vulnerability to Climate Change of Coastal People in Guinea-Bissau, West Africa
organization: Marina Padrão Temudo and Ana I. R. Cabral, University of Lisbon; Pedro Reis, National Institute of Agricultural and Veterinary Research
temporal_coverage: Djobel household survey in 2017; Diola livelihoods research 2017–2019 and follow-up fieldwork through 2022
methodology: All-household Djobel survey, interviews across five villages, repeated fieldwork and land-cover mapping.
limitations: Single island-village case; conflict history includes qualitative accounts and cited earlier records.

title: Guinea-Bissau country strategic plan (2023–2027)
temporal_coverage: Country analysis and prior flood impacts; planned WFP programming for 2023–2027
methodology: WFP country plan informed by country analysis and partner consultations in May 2022.
limitations: Plan commitments are not implementation or impact evidence; cited flood totals are not locally disaggregated.

title: Country Hydromet Diagnostics: Guinea-Bissau Peer Review Report
organization: Systematic Observations Financing Facility and World Meteorological Organization, with Guinea-Bissau National Meteorological Institute
temporal_coverage: Hydrometeorological-service capacity and observation network, assessed in 2024
methodology: Standardized WMO Country Hydromet Diagnostics using national-service information and peer review.
limitations: National service diagnostic; it does not measure community receipt of forecasts or warnings.
